$:set -euo pipefail
p=user/codespaces/shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96
state(){ gh api "$p" --jq .state; }
s=$(state); echo "INITIAL=$s"
case "$s" in Shutdown|ShuttingDown) ;; *) gh api --method POST "$p/stop" --jq .state;; esac
for i in $(seq 1 24); do s=$(state); echo "STOP_CHECK=$s"; [ "$s" = Shutdown ] && break; sleep 5; done
[ "$s" = Shutdown ] || { echo 'STOP_NOT_CONFIRMED'; exit 2; }
gh api --method POST "$p/start" --jq .state
for i in $(seq 1 24); do s=$(state); echo "START_CHECK=$s"; [ "$s" = Available ] && exit 0; sleep 5; done
exit 3
